purpose: Three first follow-up studies requested by the user: angle sparsity, estimate-then-detect BER, and filtering crossover.

BER.detector: 64-hypothesis exact Rician ML, same observations and detector for every estimated channel

inference: All 30 pilots; known complex-noise variance and reference; no true channel or true path count passed to estimators.
learning: Original 3 frozen learned checkpoints; no new neural training or test-based checkpoint selection.
sparse_selection: Held-out Rician likelihood on separate development worlds, context21/heldout9; no true-channel tuning or path-specific setting.
interpretation: Initial computational studies; 64 channels per cell limits rare-tail precision. Shared overlapping worlds across studies are not independent evidence. Any exploratory crossover refinement will be labeled.
source_policy: Old source files and manuscript unchanged. All new outputs under results/tcom_followups_20261017.
plumbing_note: Seed2026101702, first2 L2 worlds at5dB, used only to check shapes; not part of tests. Final testseed2026101712 reserved.

inputs.generator_policy: Independent operating point RNG keys include SNR and RSR; path-regime trial offsets prevent overlap; high-SNR study may explicitly couple worlds by rescaling a fixed anchor noise realization.
